testCase.name: [本地] S20 Course panels: axe (WCAG 2 A/AA) in read and edit states, and layout on phone width and WebKit

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A1 · P2 · 无障碍

按钮 / 输入框 / 下拉框没有可访问名称（养老院的 +、设置、返回、关闭 X、任务完成 / 删除、用药状态下拉等），附带部分焦点跳顶、点按区域太小

票：— · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-01/S21, OAT-06/S24b, TC-03/S21, TC-12/S20, TC-14/S22, TC-19/S21, TC-21/S20, TC-22/S20

思路 / Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S20 「病程面板：读和编辑两种状态下的 axe（WCAG 2 A/AA），以及手机宽度和 WebKit 上的布局」 Course panels: axe (WCAG 2 A/AA) in read and edit states, and layout on phone width and WebKit

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T4 The timeline is readable as a quick trend view across the stay.（TFA-92589 AC 8；UAT TC-11）
  • U3 Hospital: the timeline shows yesterday and today only, per the retention rules.（UAT TC-11；UAT 3.6；TFA-92589 AC 4）
  • U4 Nursing Home: entries are keyed by visit number and labelled 'Visit N – date'.（UAT TC-11；TFA-92589 AC 5）

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Hospital chart with two course cards and NH chart with three visit cards, one entry of 60 words each; desktop Chrome, Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit) profiles; then each timeline editor open

When The visual lane runs axe and its layout checks on hospital-chart-preround and nh-chart-preround in both states, with the course panel scrolled into view

Then No serious or critical violations; the Edit / Save / Cancel timeline buttons have accessible names, the editor textarea has a label, and the entry text meets AA contrast. Entries wrap with no horizontal scroll and no clipped text; 'Visit N – <date>' is not truncated; the Edit buttons are at least 24 px (44 pt on iPhone)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core results (visual-checks.ts): zero serious or critical violations on the four states; visual-lane overflow / truncated / tap = 0 on both course panels; screenshots for vision-review (findings, not Pass/Fail). Folded in from the former S21; a real phone is S22

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S20 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-11.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92589 ready for qa

医院病程编辑框没有可访问名称，读屏用户进去只听到一个无名文本框；iPhone 上 Edit 按钮只有 24 px 高（要求 44 pt），养老院病程标题对比度不够。

In Hospital the course-timeline editor box has no accessible name, so a screen-reader user lands in an unnamed text box. On iPhone the Edit buttons are 24 px tall (44 pt expected), and the Nursing Home course header fails contrast.

依据：allure c3cd2ce7, visual lane: 53 passed, 18 failed. axe flags 'label' as critical on the Hospital editor textarea. The layout passes: entries wrap, 'Visit N – <date>' shows in full, and Edit, Save and Cancel are named.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: TC-11 Course Timeline · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-11/S20

Course panels: axe (WCAG 2 A/AA) in read and edit states, and layout on phone width and WebKit

Tickets: TFA-92589 Course Timeline (ready for qa)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: yes）：preround.spec.ts: Hospital course (yesterday + today, 60-word entries) and NH visit timeline (3 visits); read and edit states scoped to the course panel: axe, Edit/Save/Cancel names, textarea label, overflow/truncated, 'Visit N – <date>' whole, Edit buttons >= 24 px (44 on iPhone). [2026-10-14 review] Label rule follows the oracle (axe, whose 'label' rule accepts a placeholder): judged = the textarea has an accessible name; a placeholder-only name is recorded for a person. 'truncated' added to the edit state. — A real phone is S22, not this scenario.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 53 judged check(s) passed, 18 failed. Entries wrap with no horizontal scroll or clipping; 'Visit N – <date>' lines are whole; Edit/Save/Cancel are named.

产品问题：In Hospital the course-timeline editor textarea has no accessible name at all — no label and no placeholder (axe 'label', critical): a screen-reader user lands in an unnamed text box. On iPhone the Edit buttons are 24 px tall (oracle: 44 pt on iPhone). NH course header contrast fails.

只记录的格子（recorded）：The Nursing Home timeline textarea is named only by its placeholder 'One line per visit…' (passes axe; recorded for a person, WCAG 3.3.2).

证据：附了 8 个；没附 1 个：

  • visual/evidence/TC-11_S20 — 目录（27 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
